artifacts.description: Experiment execution script with mock origin, reverse proxy, high-entropy payload generators, multi-layer encoding support, and decompression correctness controls

observations: Architecture: Client (iterative decompression, max_depth=5) -> Python Reverse Proxy -> Mock OAuth2 Server
validity_notes: Architecture: Client (iterative decompression, max_depth=5) -> Python Reverse Proxy -> Mock OAuth2 Server
Main experimental cells: 18 cells (2 sizes x 3 types x 2 multi-layer encodings)
Multi-layer encodings: GZIP-THEN-BROTLI (gzip level=1 -> brotli quality=4), BROTLI-THEN-GZIP (brotli quality=4 -> gzip level=1)
IDENTITY baselines: 6 cells (correctness oracle at 10KB and 100KB)
Seed=44 for request ordering and body generation
No real CDN infrastructure - bounded to localhost mock server + Python reverse proxy
High-entropy body generation: unique UUIDs, random floats, varied content per state
chunk_size=32 for all compressed conditions (multi-chunk framing)
10KB payloads: multi-layer compressed sizes expected ~2-10KB spanning 60-300+ chunks at chunk_size=32
100KB payloads: multi-layer compressed sizes expected ~20-99KB spanning 600-3000+ chunks at chunk_size=32
Multi-layer encodings exercise max_depth>1: iterative decompression must unwrap two layers
